references.text: God gives Moses instructions to build the tabernacle according to the pattern he was shown on the mountain.
The list of the tabernacle's parts that were to be made: the tabernacle, the tent, the covering, the clasps, the boards, the bars, the pillars, and their bases.
The description of how the craftsmen actually built the tabernacle with all its components.
Moses sets up the tabernacle and puts in place all the parts that were brought to him.
Moses completes the setting up of the tabernacle and anoints it.
The earthly tabernacle was a shadow and a copy of the heavenly one, which Moses was shown on the mountain.
Description of the first tabernacle and its furnishings as part of the old covenant.
The direct continuation of the sequence of events: the completion of the building in chapter 39 leads immediately to its erection in chapter 40.
Complementary list: 39:33 mentions the main structure, while 39:40 completes the list with the furnishings of the courtyard to show the whole picture.
Theological connection: Defines the holy function and transport responsibility for the same building components that were completed in Exodus.
Narrative continuity: 39:33 reports that the structure is ready, while 40:19 shows the next step in setting it up (the covering) of the same structure.
